title: Diffusion Self-Guidance for Controllable Image Generation
property: position, size, shape and appearance of named words
reads: Softmax-normalized word cross-attention maps from all 36 Imagen layers at 8x8, 16x16 and 32x32; appearance also reads U-Net activations inside the soft mask
trained_on: nothing trained; hand-written L1 energies on centroid, thresholded size, thresholded shape and masked activations
gradient_enters: eps_hat = (1+s) eps(z;t,y) - s eps(z;t,null) + v sigma_t grad_z g, with v = 7500 on the first 3N/16 DDPM steps and alternating steps until the last N/32
unseen: no: nothing is learned, so no concept is held out
headline: No quantitative metric or baseline score is reported; qualitative Imagen 1024 x 1024 results use v = 7500 and N = 1024 DDPM steps
copy_or_avoid: Copy the centroid and soft-threshold formulas but add an absolute attention signal, because min-max normalization can make a missing subject look present; test maps for species leakage (inferred)
